subject.title: Session bloat: skillsSnapshot and systemPromptReport accumulated on every run

question: Should OpenClaw keep the full `systemPromptReport` inline in every session entry, or persist only the smaller restart/dedupe state needed from that report?
rationale: Current tests intentionally preserve the report for warning dedupe, while production data shows that the same object now dominates large session stores; automation should not choose the durable metadata boundary alone.

options.title: Persist Only Dedupe State
options.body: Store the minimal warning-signature state needed after restart and omit or recompute large tools, skills, and prompt-report details from inactive session rows.

options.title: Keep Full Report Inline
options.body: Accept larger `sessions.json` rows and rely on pruning, entry caps, and operator cleanup rather than changing the report durability contract.

options.title: Move Report To Canonical Store
options.body: Move large report details out of the session index into an approved canonical store with cleanup semantics, instead of adding an unowned sidecar file.

recommendation.title: Persist Only Dedupe State
recommendation.body: Store the minimal warning-signature state needed after restart and omit or recompute large tools, skills, and prompt-report details from inactive session rows.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest history signal for both the original prompt-report surface and the current prompt-blob mitigation.
